summary.business_type: B2B industrial services (mechanical, electrical, automation contractor) with local/regional offices in Bekasi, Malang and Timika (hybrid local service)
top_findings: /sitemap.xml returns HTTP 500 with the full Laravel debug (Ignition) error page: ParseError at resources/views/sitemap.blade.php:1
Production runs with APP_DEBUG enabled, exposing stack traces, file paths, PHP 8.4.27 and Laravel 13.37.0 to anyone
Live robots.txt is Cloudflare's managed file with no Sitemap line; the app's own robots route (Disallow: /admin + Sitemap) is not what crawlers see
Mobile pages are slow: LCP 4.7-22.7 s on throttled mobile (target under 2.5 s), driven by ~4-5 MB of unoptimized photos per page
Homepage and /license load Tailwind via the cdn.tailwindcss.com runtime compiler and lucide@latest, both render-blocking and not meant for production
quick_wins: Set APP_DEBUG=false and APP_ENV=production on the server, then php artisan config:cache
Fix /sitemap.xml and submit it in Google Search Console
Turn off Cloudflare 'Managed robots.txt' (or add a Sitemap: line to it) so the app's robots.txt is served
Add loading="lazy" plus width/height to below-the-fold images; convert photos to WebP at <=1600px wide
Use a real 1200x630 og:image instead of the logo for social sharing

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: HTTPS with HTTP->HTTPS redirect
All 5 pages return 200 with self-referencing canonicals
Server-rendered HTML (not a SPA); modal/pop-up content is present in the HTML so crawlers can read it
Proper 404 for unknown URLs; x-content-type-options and x-frame-options set

findings.title: Sitemap returns HTTP 500
findings.description: GET /sitemap.xml -> 500, ParseError 'syntax error, unexpected identifier "version"' at resources/views/sitemap.blade.php:1 (from the XML prolog line). Search engines cannot discover pages through a sitemap.
findings.recommendation: Fix the XML prolog output (e.g. emit it from the controller or split the '<?' token), redeploy, clear compiled views (php artisan view:clear), then submit the sitemap in Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools.

findings.title: Debug mode enabled in production
findings.description: The 500 response is the full Laravel debug page (~900 KB) revealing stack trace, file paths, PHP and Laravel versions. Any error on the site leaks the same.
findings.recommendation: Set APP_ENV=production and APP_DEBUG=false in the server .env, run php artisan config:cache.

findings.title: robots.txt has no Sitemap directive
findings.description: Live robots.txt is Cloudflare's managed content-signals file. The app route that adds 'Disallow: /admin' and 'Sitemap:' is not reflected in the live file.
findings.recommendation: In Cloudflare > Security > Bots, disable Managed robots.txt or confirm it appends the origin file; verify the live file ends with Sitemap: https://trissan.mdhost.site/sitemap.xml.

findings.title: Duplicate URL variants return 200
findings.description: /index.php and /about/ (trailing slash) both return 200 instead of redirecting. Canonicals mitigate it.
findings.recommendation: 301 /index.php to / and trailing-slash URLs to the slashless version (default Laravel .htaccess does the latter).

findings.title: No HSTS header
findings.description: No Strict-Transport-Security header on responses.
findings.recommendation: Enable HSTS in Cloudflare SSL/TLS > Edge Certificates.

findings.title: /favicon.ico returns 404 with a meta-refresh body
findings.description: The favicon route redirects via an HTML meta refresh with status 404.
findings.recommendation: Serve a real favicon.ico (or a 301 to the PNG).

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Named, verifiable client projects (Astra Honda Motor, Mayora, Nihon Plast, Indofood) are strong experience/trust signals
Company profile PDF, certificates and an org chart support E-E-A-T
Full physical address and two phone numbers present

findings.title: No dedicated page per service
findings.description: 12 services only exist as one-line blurbs and ?category= filters on /works. There is no URL that can rank for e.g. 'jasa instalasi fire hydrant Bekasi' or 'pembuatan konveyor'.
findings.recommendation: Create a page per core service (300-800 words: scope, process, equipment, project photos, area served, FAQ, CTA).

findings.title: Mixed English and Indonesian headings
findings.description: Services, project titles and 'Contact Us' are English while body copy and meta are Indonesian (lang=id). Indonesian searchers will mostly query in Indonesian.
findings.recommendation: Use Indonesian primary headings with English terms in parentheses where the industry uses them (e.g. 'Sistem Konveyor (Material Handling)').

findings.title: Thin project entries
findings.description: Each project has one sentence. No scope, duration, challenge, result or numbers.
findings.recommendation: Expand top projects into short case studies (problem, solution, specs, outcome, photos).

findings.title: No author/people signals on content
findings.description: Team exists on /portofolio but no named engineer credentials tied to work.
findings.recommendation: Add engineer names, certifications (e.g. K3 Listrik) and years of experience.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique titles 26-62 chars and meta descriptions 124-155 chars on all pages
Exactly one H1 per page
Open Graph and Twitter tags present on all pages
Good internal linking between home, works and service categories

findings.title: Weak keyword targeting in titles
findings.description: Titles lack location and high-intent service terms ('Tentang Kami | PT. Trissan').
findings.recommendation: e.g. 'Kontraktor Mekanikal & Elektrikal Industri di Bekasi | PT. Trissan'.

findings.title: Heading hierarchy issues
findings.description: Homepage has 12 H3s before the first H2; /works has an empty H2; H1s on /portofolio, /license, /works are ALL CAPS in source.
findings.recommendation: Wrap the service grid under an H2, remove the empty H2, write H1s in sentence case and uppercase via CSS.

findings.title: og:image is the logo on every page
findings.description: Shares on WhatsApp/LinkedIn/Facebook show a logo, not a project photo.
findings.recommendation: Use a 1200x630 image per page.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Valid JSON-LD Organization + WebSite on every page, BreadcrumbList on inner pages
PostalAddress and ContactPoint included

findings.title: No LocalBusiness schema
findings.description: Organization only; no geo, openingHours, areaServed, or the Malang/Timika branches.
findings.recommendation: Add LocalBusiness (or ProfessionalService) with geo, openingHoursSpecification, areaServed and department entries for each office.

findings.title: No Service schema
findings.description: Services are not described in structured data.
findings.recommendation: Add Service items (provider = Organization) on the future service pages.

findings.title: No sameAs links
findings.description: Facebook and Instagram links point to the generic facebook.com / instagram.com homepages, not company profiles.
findings.recommendation: Link the real profiles and add them to sameAs (plus LinkedIn and Google Business Profile).

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Desktop is fast: LCP 0.7-2.1 s on all pages
CLS is good everywhere (0.00-0.05, target under 0.1)
Cloudflare CDN in front of the origin, images cached 4h

findings.title: Mobile LCP is 4.7-22.7 s (target under 2.5 s)
findings.description: Measured in headless Edge with slow-4G-like throttling (1.6 Mbps, 150 ms latency, 4x CPU). / LCP 18.4s / 4.8 MB; /about LCP 9.6s / 1.8 MB; /portofolio LCP 22.7s / 4.2 MB; /license LCP 4.7s / 0.6 MB; /works LCP 22.3s / 4.2 MB. The LCP element is a hero/project photo on 4 of 5 pages. Google indexes the mobile version, so this is the speed that counts.
findings.recommendation: Resize and convert images to WebP (target <150 KB for heroes, <80 KB for cards), add fetchpriority="high" to the first hero image, lazy-load everything below the fold.

findings.title: Tailwind CDN runtime compiler in production
findings.description: home and license (and about) load cdn.tailwindcss.com, which compiles CSS in the browser on every visit and blocks rendering. Tailwind's docs say it is not for production.
findings.recommendation: Use the project's Vite build (@vite) for CSS like the other pages.

findings.title: Unpinned lucide@latest from unpkg
findings.description: Render-blocking script with a floating version; slower and can break without warning.
findings.recommendation: Bundle lucide via npm/Vite or pin an exact version with defer.

findings.title: Heavy origin response time
findings.description: HTML responses 1.5-4.3 s from a test client (cfOrigin 530 ms on homepage; /license 4.3 s); Cache-Control: no-cache.
findings.recommendation: Cache settings queries, run php artisan optimize, and consider Cloudflare page caching for anonymous visitors.

findings.title: Measurement method
findings.description: Google PageSpeed Insights API was rate-limited (429) both times; numbers are from a local throttled lab run, not Google field data (no CrUX data exists for this site yet).
findings.recommendation: Confirm on pagespeed.web.dev after fixes.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Content-Signal: search=yes; search-type crawlers (Googlebot, Bingbot, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot) are allowed
Content is plain server-rendered HTML with clear Q&A-able facts (address, clients, services)

findings.title: Cloudflare blocks many AI bots
findings.description: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, GoogleOther, CCBot, Applebot-Extended etc. are disallowed. This is a valid choice for training opt-out but reduces how often assistants know about the company.
findings.recommendation: Decide deliberately; for a B2B contractor wanting visibility, consider allowing at least GPTBot and ClaudeBot.

findings.title: No FAQ / citable answer passages
findings.description: No passages that directly answer questions buyers ask (lead time, area served, certifications).
findings.recommendation: Add short FAQ sections on service pages.

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.description: Optional; ignored by Google Search.
findings.recommendation: Optional low-priority addition.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Most images have descriptive Indonesian alt text

findings.title: Very large image files
findings.description: Sampled 18 images = 7.1 MB. work-7.jpg 785 KB, work-5.jpg 623 KB, logo.png 336 KB, about-hero/teaser PNG 388 KB each.
findings.recommendation: Resize to display size (max ~1600px), convert to WebP/AVIF, logo to SVG or a <20 KB PNG.

findings.title: No width/height attributes
findings.description: 0 of 47 img tags have width/height. Measured CLS is still good (max 0.053 on /portofolio) because containers have fixed sizes, so this is a safeguard rather than an active problem.
findings.recommendation: Add width and height (or aspect-ratio CSS) to every img.

findings.title: No lazy loading on homepage
findings.description: All 13 homepage images load eagerly, including footer images.
findings.recommendation: loading="lazy" on below-the-fold images; fetchpriority="high" on the first hero image.

findings.title: Missing alt text
findings.description: One image without alt on each of /portofolio, /license and /works.
findings.recommendation: Add alt text (or alt="" if decorative).

categories.name: Mobile & Visual (not weighted)
what_works: Responsive layout on all 5 pages at 412 px; no horizontal overflow seen
Clear H1 and value proposition above the fold on the homepage
Bottom tab navigation (Home, Works, Portofolio, About, Lisensi) is thumb-friendly
Hero trust badge names recognisable clients (Yamaha, Yaskawa, Daikin, Freeport)

findings.title: Header 'Kontak' button nearly invisible on /works
findings.description: On the /works mobile screenshot the top-right contact button renders light-on-light and is barely visible, hiding the main call to action.
findings.recommendation: Give the button the same dark style it has on the homepage.

findings.title: Off-topic placeholder text in the works search box
findings.description: Search placeholder mentions 'Ti-6Al-4V, 7075-T6', aerospace alloys unrelated to the listed projects; looks like template leftover.
findings.recommendation: Use examples from your own work, e.g. 'konveyor, fire hydrant, panel PLC'.

findings.title: Client names in hero not linked to proof
findings.description: Yamaha, Yaskawa, Daikin and Freeport appear only as badges; none has a matching project on /works.
findings.recommendation: Add at least one documented project per named client, or a client logo wall with project links.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Serve robots.txt with Sitemap line (Cloudflare managed robots)
Submit sitemap to Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Replace Tailwind CDN with Vite build on home/about/license
Compress and resize images to WebP, add width/height and lazy loading

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: One page per core service (Indonesian, with location)
Create/verify Google Business Profile for Bekasi (and branches)

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Watch GSC coverage and queries monthly
Run PageSpeed Insights mobile after deploy
